transcript_text: Great. Well, you two are both selected as astronauts in 2013. I know you've been training together. You're up there already. Christina's there with a couple of other astronauts from the 2013 class and McLean and Nick Hague and then Drew Morgan is also going to be launching in July. So it's like one big class party for y'all.
